question: Does exact variable-incidence component factorization of the hardened affine-core-plus-defects representation compress the AV branch product to a polynomial L^4 budget, or does a reachable connected component itself exceed the unchanged budget?

frozen_representation.extractor: AT hardened affine extraction with explicit tautology removal
frozen_representation.constraint_nodes: one node for every recognized GF(2) affine equation and one node for every non-affine defect clause
frozen_representation.variable_nodes: one node for every variable occurring in an effective constraint
frozen_representation.edges: constraint-variable incidence; an edge exists iff the variable occurs in that affine equation or defect clause
frozen_representation.components: ordinary connected components of the undirected bipartite constraint-variable factor graph
frozen_representation.semantic_independence_condition: no variable occurs in constraints belonging to two different components
frozen_representation.component_defect_product: P_j = product of widths of all defect clauses in component j; empty product = 1
frozen_representation.compressed_branch_cost: B_component = sum of P_j over components containing at least one defect
frozen_representation.L: literal count of the effective canonical residual after explicit tautology removal

frozen_door_candidate.accept_if: factorization contract passes and B_component <= L^4
frozen_door_candidate.polynomial_claim_scope: only this exact component-factorized branch enumeration plus polynomial Gaussian-elimination overhead on the frozen audited states
frozen_door_candidate.reject_if: any single connected component defect product, or the sum B_component, exceeds L^4

frozen_domain.source_generator: the exact nine preregistered AV candidates from janus_trump_r50g25av_reachable_multi_defect_growth_witness.frozen_candidates()
frozen_domain.candidate_order: identical AV literal order: local k=[2,5,8,16,24,32], then shifted sealed-Y copy_count=[1,2,3]
frozen_domain.policy_replay: exact inherited AS/AU deterministic cheap-policy replay

frozen_stopping_rule: audit candidates in frozen order and stop scientifically at the first reachable factor-graph component-cost obstruction B_component > L^4; implementation may physically compute later preregistered candidates but they do not affect the first-obstruction verdict
